purpose: Determine whether SMP MasterSite > child Site panels are numerous and complete enough for prospective macroecological testing before inspecting abundance outcomes.

required_fields: Plot or equivalent site-vs-plot indicator if available in current export

exposed_pilot_exclusions.reason: Count magnitudes were viewed during structural audit.

primary_record_filter.spatial_level: Site-level Whole Colony Count only; exclude non-whole Plot Colony Counts
primary_record_filter.merged_total_policy: exclude rows explicitly identified as merged totals
primary_record_filter.missing_policy: absence of a record is missing, never zero
primary_record_filter.zero_policy: recorded zero/nil return is an observed ecological zero
primary_record_filter.unit_policy: one common Unit within each species x MasterSite panel; no unit conversion
primary_record_filter.method_policy: each retained Site may have at most one non-missing Method code across the primary panel
primary_record_filter.duplicate_policy: byte-identical duplicates may collapse; otherwise multiple competing Site x year counts make that Site-year unavailable

fixed_roster_algorithm: Within each species x MasterSite x Unit, start with all child SiteIDs having >=10 eligible observed years.
If fewer than 3 SiteIDs remain, fail the panel.
Calculate complete years: years in which every currently retained SiteID has an eligible observed count.
If complete years >=10, stop and retain the full current roster.
Otherwise remove the SiteID with the fewest eligible observed years and repeat.
If tied, remove the lexicographically greatest SiteID.
If roster size falls below 3 before reaching 10 complete years, fail the panel.
support_outputs_allowed_before_outcomes: number of eligible species x MasterSite panels
count unit and stable method metadata
number and calendar span of complete years

decision_gate.go_macro_if: At least 20 eligible species x MasterSite panels across at least 5 species and at least 3 broad geographic regions survive the support rule.
decision_gate.fallback_if_failed: Do not rescue by lowering thresholds after seeing counts. Keep the frozen Ecology Report as the primary paper and treat SMP as unavailable for this macro route.
